answer:
Based on my research, here is the information you requested:

## City and Brick Company
The city is **Mexico, Missouri**, where Frank Cordie started the **Mid America Brick** company around 2010. The Obama White House featured this project as an example of revitalizing local industry through federal programs like Rural Business and Industry Loan Guarantees.

## Elementary Schools Teaching Up to Grade 5 in the Mexico School District #59

The two elementary schools that serve students through grade 5 are located on these streets:

| School Name | Street Name | Full Address |
|-------------|-------------|--------------|
| **Eugene Field Elementary School** | West Blvd (W Boulevard St) | 704 West Blvd, Mexico, MO 65265 |
| **Hawthorne Elementary School** | W Curtis St (West Curtis Street) | 1250 W Curtis St, Mexico, MO 65265 |

*Note: McMillan Early Learning Center in the district only serves PreK-K and does not meet your "up to grade 5" requirement.*
